keyRules: Maximum altitude: 122 m (400 ft) above ground level (RAC 100).
Maximum horizontal distance: 750 m from the operator, while maintaining direct visual line of sight (VLOS) (RAC 100).
Drones with an MTOW of 200 g or more: mandatory registration on Aerocivil’s UAS Platform
Registered drone: carries a fixed label of at least 2 × 4 cm with the registration number, name, email and atencionalciudadano@aerocivil.gov.co (RAC 100).
Open Category (drones ≤25 kg, non-commercial use only): operation permitted without prior authorization under RAC 100. Commercial use = Specific Category with authorization.
Drones over 25 kg (up to 250 kg): only in the Specific Category, with a flight authorization from Aerocivil and a pilot holding a certificate of suitability (RAC 100).
Minimum distance of 2 km from military or police bases, prisons and critical infrastructure, and from any place where the President is present (RAC 100).

Airports: flying is prohibited at the airport and within 6 km of the reference point (ARP); between 6 and 9 km only in the Open Category, maximum 61 m (200 ft) above the lowest threshold and outside ZNVD — check the Visor Geográfico UAS (RAC 100).
Minimum distance of 3 km from heliports (RAC 100).
A minimum distance of 30 m from people and buildings not involved
Always keep the drone within direct line of sight (VLOS). At night only with lights permanently on and with an observer (RAC 100).
Drone No-Fly Zones (ZNVD) and prohibited, restricted and danger areas can be checked in Aerocivil's Visor Geográfico UAS (RAC 100).
importantNotes: 📋 RAC 100 (currently in effect): the main regulation governing drones in Colombia. It replaces the previous RAC 91, Appendix 13. It establishes the Open Category (operation without prior authorization) and the Specific Category (with authorization). Circular 100-MAUT-5.0-22-010-CI provides step-by-step guidance on the registration process.
✈️ TOURISTS: RAC 100 also applies to foreigners. Drones from 200 g are registered on the Plataforma UAS Colombia with a valid passport; the process is free of charge.

🌳 NATIONAL PARKS AND PROTECTED AREAS: Colombia’s National Natural Parks (PNN) prohibit drones without special permission in parks such as Tayrona, Cocuy, Los Nevados, and Amacayacu. The Colombian Caribbean and the Amazon region have additional restrictions—check with each park before your trip.
🏛️ RESTRICTED AREAS: flying is prohibited in ZNVD zones (e.g. around El Dorado SKBO) — check Aerocivil's Visor Geográfico UAS before every flight.

💰 PENALTIES AND LIABILITY: Operating without registration or outside permitted areas may result in significant fines (UVT — Tax Value Unit), confiscation of equipment, and, in serious cases, criminal liability. For commercial use: liability insurance is required.

fields.disclaimerText: Always check the official sources of the Civil Aviation Authority (Aerocivil) before flying. This app is a tool, not a legal authority. Colombia enforces RAC 100 (Aeronautical Regulations for UAS Operations), which requires mandatory registration for drones with a MTOW of 200 g or more via the UAS Platform.
